author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Thanks to a new controller and a handy software update, I actually enjoy using the Nintendo Switch 2 in handheld mode. Let's check out the Mobapad M12 HD and the new Handheld Mode Boost.

Mobapad M12 HD: https://www.mobapad.com/products/mobapad-m12-switch-2-joycon
Carrying case: https://www.mobapad.com/products/mobapad-h12-carrying-case-for-mobapad-m12

Other options mentioned in the video:
dbrand KillSwitch 2: https://dbrand.com/shop/killswitch/nintendo-switch-2-cases
Genki Grips: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/humanthings/genkigrips
Mechanism Basecase: https://getmechanism.com/pages/switch-2-basegrip
Nitro Deck 2: https://crkd.gg/pages/nitro-deck-2
Genki Dual Wield: https://www.genkithings.com/products/dualwield
dbrand grips: https://dbrand.com/shop/killswitch/nintendo-switch-2-joy-con-grips

The controller was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this video ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.

title: The Switch 2 is Finally a Great Handheld
